title: Our Team
header_subtitle: Developing the robustness and resilience of territories in the face of climate change.

team_section.title: The Lychen Team
team_section.description: We are a team dedicated to creating an open-source digital ecosystem. Our mission: to connect citizens, producers, associations, and local authorities to promote sustainable agriculture and biodiversity protection.

ecosystem_section.title: A transparent and interconnected ecosystem
ecosystem_section.description: Lychen offers concrete tools for the territory: market gardening, beekeeping, bio-waste management, and biodiversity. We facilitate collaboration among all local actors around the Sustainable Development Goals.
